name: NarrativeSemant-MCP
description: Clinical narrative analysis, uncertainty detection, and orphaned intention identification. The purest AI node in CTIB.

tools.name: extract_clinical_assertions
tools.description: Extract every factual clinical assertion from clinical documents using LLM with structured extraction. Identifies stated, hedged, and uncertain assertions.

documents.description: FHIR DocumentReference resources with base64-encoded content

tools.name: detect_uncertainty_language
tools.description: Detect hedged language, unresolved differentials, conditional intentions, and deferred actions within clinical documents. Cross-references against subsequent documents for resolution checking.

tools.name: identify_open_questions
tools.description: THE MONEY PROMPT — Find orphaned clinical intentions: things a clinician stated they would do but never followed up on. Generates FHIR Task resources for each orphaned intention with exact source citations.
